summary: Execute Phase 2 legacy business-workspace UI recovery on the Phase 1 integration base: preserve accepted canonical owners, restore legacy-visible workspace entry composition and interactions across batches A, B and C, and add regression coverage without donor backend, duplicate routes, fake persistence, or parallel business truth.
